messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT — hosted-api queue growth detected for service=hosted-rtu-us-east-1. GPU pool 'v2-pool-us-east-1' provisioning stuck in WAIT state. p95 ↑ 4s -> 9s, p99 ↑ 8s -> 32s. Error: provider create returned 429/QuotaExceeded for 12/15 recent attempts. @erica_oncall paging now :rotating_light:

erica_oncall: I’m on it. pulling logs and checking autoscaler state. tagging SRE.

ian_sre: seeing steady backlog on /v1/generate. queue depth climbed from 2k -> 27k in ~8m. active GPUs unchanged at 48. provisioning attempts show create_timeouts and 429s.

jas_runtime: provisioning agent logs:
```
2026-02-14T03:14:22Z provisioner: request create vm count=12 id=req-8a3b
2026-02-14T03:14:23Z cloudapi: 429 TooManyRequests create vm req-8a3b retry=1
2026-02-14T03:14:25Z provisioner: heartbeat OK but lease pending, state=WAIT_FOR_QUOTA
2026-02-14T03:14:40Z provisioner: backoff 30s
```
looks like cloud-side rate limiting + regional quota baseline exhausted.

erica_oncall: immediate mitigations? can we open a temporary thin-provisioned pool or route high-latency requests to reduced-q models?

jas_runtime: we can flip routing key to route non-SLA traffic to small-quantized variants (gpt-small-q4) from the runtime side — that cuts GPU compute ~3x. doing feature flag toggle would be ~2m.

ian_sre: also can enable emergency thin-provisioning: use preemptible spot nodes from us-east-2 through edge routing. risk: variable latency, but will reduce queue. need platform owner approval.

maria_support: support ticket surge already incoming — customer AcmePay reported timeouts and 504s. I’m classifying customers impacted by SLA to inform sales.

luke_pm: priority list: AcmePay (SLA 99.9), NimbusRetail (non-critical), internal test tenants. notify enterprise sales for AcmePay.

erica_oncall: timeline: 1) toggle runtime routing to gpt-small-q4 for non-enterprise traffic (T+2m) 2) request emergency thin-provisioning to us-east-2 spot (T+6m) 3) escalate quota to cloud account owner (T+10m). initiating step 1 now.

ops-bot: ACTION logged: incident_id=inc-20260214-7854312, severity=page, runbook=hosted-gpu-queue-growth. oncall=erica_oncall.

jas_runtime: feature-flag toggle done — non-enterprise traffic now routed to gpt-small-q4. Observability: token throughput per GPU rose 2.8x, p95 starting to drop.

ian_sre: queue decreased from 27k -> 9k in 3m after routing change. p99 down from 32s -> 6.5s for routed traffic. enterprise traffic still queued.

erica_oncall: filing cloud support ticket with provider for quota bump and explaining production impact. linking logs and request IDs.

jas_runtime: kickstarting emergency thin-provision: submitting create with different region and instance type, using spot; patching routing table to prefer us-east-2 for new allocations.

ops-bot: deploy bot: routing-change applied by jas_runtime at 03:18:10Z.

ian_sre: provisioning to us-east-2 succeeded for 8 nodes. Active GPUs now 56. queue trending down to 2.1k. enterprise backfills beginning.

maria_support: AcmePay notified via support channel and provided mitigation steps and ETA ~12m for full restoration. They're escalating internally but appreciated the heads-up.

erica_oncall: current status: partial mitigation via routing + thin-provisioning. investigating root cause: cloud quota exhaustion, plus aggressive client-side campaign creating thundering fanout of small requests. recommend rate-limit rule per-tenant and short-term client-side throttling for unverified apps.

luke_pm: please prepare Impact Summary for customers and a post-incident action list (quota guardrails, per-tenant rate limits, improved autoscaler backoff). I'll coordinate comms.

jas_runtime: quick notes: need to add exponential backoff with jitter to provisioner create path and implement cross-region auto-failover in provisioner. also add 'emergency-spot' pool config to runbook.

ian_sre: monitoring alarms: add alert when queue growth > 5k within 5m and provider 429 rate > 5/min.

erica_oncall: will hand off to night oncall in 45m after we confirm queue stable <500 for 15m. setting followup: postmortem owner=ian_sre, mitigation ticket assigned to jas_runtime.

maria_support: opened consolidated customer impact doc: https://redwoodinternal/incident/inc-7854312/customers (internal) — listing impacted customers and ETA notes.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity downgraded to incident (monitoring) at 03:30:00Z. queue stable and p99 back to baseline for most traffic.

erica_oncall: handing to @ian_sre for post-incident ops. thanks team. :point_up:
